newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end lower on ample liquidity.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed lower on Friday as ample liquidity buoyed buying sentiment despite relatively heavy new issues, brokers said.
Three-month CDs ended unchanged in slow trading, while the overnight call rate fell slightly, they said.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.45 pct from 12.47 pct
* Overnight call average 12.89 pct from 12.97 pct
"The three-year yields fell to a low of 12.38 in the morning. But profit-taking followed after the central bank siphoned off money in circulation," Kim said.
Three-month CDs ended unchanged in slow trading, while the overnight call rate fell slightly, they said.
